case_number: 2024 INSC 722; WRIT PETITION (CRL.) No. 166 OF 2023 with Misc. Applications No. 1861, 1862 and Interlocutory Applications No. 138072, 150965 of 2023

parties.respondent: The State of West Bengal and others

summary: Civil dispute criminalized via multiple FIRs; Article 32 petition for quashing abuse-of-process FIRs; interim stay granted; subsequent High Court referrals with six-month disposal directive; misc. applications seeking modification/recall rejected; binding precedent on disposed-case applications: rare exception only for executory impossibility or ends of justice; inherent powers under Order LV Rule 6 preserved; finality of judgments imperative per Rashid Khan Pathan.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 32 of the Constitution of India
Order LV Rule 6 of Supreme Court Rules, 2013
final_judgment: Appeals against modification/recall applications dismissed; original interim protection maintained; High Courts directed to dispose petitions within six months.
